final: Day reached — streak overlay as on this page (phone underlays + Training Hub Lottie). Colour wheel is a tester only; ship the celebration geometry and timing, not the wheel chrome.
summary: When the player hits their daily step goal mid-activity (for example mid-story, story completion, or upcoming gems challenges), a soft celebration plays over the current screen: haze in, Lottie bloom on today’s bead, side beads settle, short streak copy, shine, then dissolve. This does not replace Training Hub or Step Glance animations; it replaces the simple goal-reached notification for that mid-activity moment.

rows.then: A red dot / cue waits until Training Hub (or this overlay path) is shown; celebration is ready to play once.
Soft haze fades in over the current screen. Today’s bead slot runs the day-reached Lottie bloom with accent glow.
Past weekday beads fade in; streak copy appears (e.g. “3-day streak!” / “Keep it up!” — Writing owns final strings); future beads follow; prolonged shine, then soft dissolve out.
Overlay is gone; underlay / hub UI is unchanged underneath.
Celebration (arc glow, Lottie tint, shine) recolours. Layout, bead sizes, and timing stay the same.
Phone-only shell; parent sends play / accent postMessages. No page chrome.

events.name: day_goal_reached
events.when: Daily step goal is met for the first time that day.

edgeCases: Celebration plays once per day after the goal is hit; reopening the hub later that day does not replay it.
Sound and haptics are app-only (DayReachedCelebrationCue) — not in this web experiment.
Reduce Motion: keep a readable settle without the full bloom if the app already softens motion elsewhere.
Underlays in the experiment are staging screenshots for placement only — do not ship them as product UI.
